extName.message: TokenLens for Claude – Usage & Limit Tracker
extName.description: Extension name in browser toolbar and Chrome Web Store

extDescription.message: Real-time token usage, context window, rate limits & 5 hour/7 day quotas — directly inside your chat.
extDescription.description: Extension description in Chrome Web Store

quota5hTip.message:
Your rolling 5-hour usage quota.

Resets 5 hours after your first message
in the current window. Shared across all
conversations on this account.

Token-weighted: long messages and detailed
responses consume more quota than short ones.

quota7dTip.message:
Your rolling 7-day usage quota.

Resets 7 days after your first message
in the current window. Shared across all
conversations on this account.

Fills more slowly than the 5h quota — this
is the longer-term ceiling on your usage.

ctxPillLabel.description: Label on the context window pill

ctxPillTip.message:
Estimated context window usage.

Token counting (heuristic):
· Code blocks: chars ÷ 3
· URLs & numbers: chars ÷ 2
· Regular text: words × 1.3

As this approaches 100%, Claude may start
losing memory of earlier messages.
Model limit shown as denominator.
ctxPillTip.description: Tooltip on the context window pill

spdPillTip.message:
Output speed of the last response.
Measured in tokens per second (t/s).

Typical range: 30–80 t/s.
Lower during peak hours or on longer outputs.

turnsPillTip.message:
Number of complete assistant responses
sent in this conversation session.
turnsPillTip.description: Tooltip on the turn count pill

costPillTip.message:
Estimated token cost at Claude API rates.
Input + output tokens combined.

Claude.ai subscriptions are flat-rate —
this is a reference figure, not what
you’re actually charged.
costPillTip.description: Tooltip on the estimated cost pill

latPillTip.message:
Average time-to-first-token (TTFT)
across all responses this session.

Measures how long the server takes to start
responding — not total generation time.
Higher during peak hours.
latPillTip.description: Tooltip on the average latency pill

msgQuotaTip.message: How much of your usage limit this message used.
msgQuotaTip.description: Tooltip on the per-message quota-usage chip

chipLatTip.message: How long Claude took to start replying.
chipLatTip.description: Tooltip on the per-message latency chip

chipSpdTip.message: How fast Claude generated this reply.
chipSpdTip.description: Tooltip on the per-message speed chip

chipOutTip.message: How many tokens this reply contains.
chipOutTip.description: Tooltip on the per-message output-token chip

chipCachedTip.message: This reply reused a cached prompt, so it was cheaper and faster.
chipCachedTip.description: Tooltip on the per-message cached chip

chipMaxedTip.message: Claude stopped early — the reply hit its length limit.
chipMaxedTip.description: Tooltip on the per-message limit-hit chip

ghostCost.description: Estimated cost label in ghost overlay

ghostLatency.description: Average latency label in ghost overlay

peakTip.message:
Peak hours: Mon–Fri 5AM–11AM PT.
Higher server load during peak.

uncachedText.description: Text when the conversation's prompt cache is not active

cacheTip.message:
Whether this conversation is using a cached prompt.
Cached replies are usually faster and cheaper.

toolbar5hTip.message:
5-hour quota usage.
Resets 5h after your first message in the window.
Token-weighted — longer exchanges fill it faster.
toolbar5hTip.description: Tooltip on the 5h bar in the toolbar

toolbar7dTip.message:
7-day quota usage.
Resets 7 days after your first message in the window.
The longer-term ceiling on your account usage.
toolbar7dTip.description: Tooltip on the 7d bar in the toolbar

chipOut.description: Short label after output token count e.g. 342 out

welcomeTitle.message: Stay in your flow. We’ll watch the clock.

welcomeBody.message: TokenLens shows how much of your 5-hour limit is left, right where you chat, so a limit never catches you off guard.

privacyLine.message: Runs only on claude.ai. Nothing leaves your browser.

popupReload.message: Reload this tab to turn TokenLens on.

popupOpen.message: Open Claude to see your usage.

popupWish.message: May your limits stay far away.

reviewTitle.message: Is TokenLens keeping you in flow?

reviewBody.message: Reviews are how other people find TokenLens. If it has earned it, five stars goes a long way.

reviewThanksBody.message: Your review page just opened in a new tab. It takes about 20 seconds, and it helps more than you’d think.

reviewLowBody.message: Tell us what’s missing and we’ll work on it. It takes a minute.

whatsNewTitle.message: You can now hide the widget

whatsNewBody.message: Tap ✕ to tuck it away. Bring it back anytime from the gauge icon in the top bar.

fbBody.message: TokenLens grows one idea at a time, and most of them come from people like you. A feature, a bugfix, a tiny annoyance: one sentence is plenty.

fbEx1.message: do that thing I keep wishing for

fbEx2.message: stop doing that one annoying thing

fbThanksBody.message: The form is open in a new tab. A real person reads every answer.
